sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:31

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:31:1
items.html: Atik takes the tastes of BON to make his Nukva, which are the first five in the Keter of BON: It has already been explained above, in the adjacent item, that the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, which emerged there all at once, cannot be corrected in the new MA all together, but only one after the other. Therefore, when Atik, which is the Sefira of Keter, was corrected, nothing at all could be sorted out of the discernment of Hochma. Study it there well. For this reason the discernment of the lower half of the Keter of Nekudim was not joined to the discernment of Atik of MA, because it is the discernment of the NHY of Keter that had clothed as Mochin in AVI, and therefore they descended from the degree of Keter to the degree of Hochma, and are no longer fit to be joined into the Keter of Atzilut in the first Rosh. And what he says, that they are the first five Sefirot, means that they are half of the degree. For from the time of the ascent of the bottom Hey into the Einayim, all the degrees were divided into two halves: GE and AHP, since only its upper half remains in its degree, which is GE, while its lower half went outside the degree and is regarded as lower than it, as the ARI writes in Etz Chaim, Gate 40, Discourse 8. And these are his words: “This is a great rule by which you will understand everything, for the second Partzuf is always the half of the upper one.” End of quote. This is the most important key in the wisdom, one that must always be kept before one’s eyes, for most of the knots of the wisdom are clarified through it. In truth there are only two Sefirot in the upper part, those that emerged from the beginning of its emanation, called Galgalta ve Einayim, while in the lower part, which went outside the degree, there are three Sefirot: Bina, ZA and Nukva. Yet since those two are the upper Sefirot, they are reckoned as a half.

items.html:
He also takes the GAR of the Sefira of Hochma, and the first four of the Bina of BON: The reason for this is that you already know that the place where the Rosh of Atik of MA stands is from the place of the Peh of Nekudim upward, up to the Tabur of AK, as above (page 611, the passage beginning “However”), which is the place where the GAR of Nekudim stand. Therefore, everything that remained in the GAR of Nekudim after the breaking of the vessels was taken by the male of Atik, who clothes there, that is, whatever emerged from the beginning of their emanation, which is really the discernment of the Katnut of GAR and the discernment of back to back. However, since they are the discernment of Galgalta ve Einayim of the degree, he calls them by the name GAR, for the whole matter of Gadlut is nothing but the return of Bina and ZON to the degree, since through the lowering of the bottom Hey to the Peh, Bina and ZON return to the degree, and then they acquire the GAR of Gadlut. Thus what actually emerged in Katnut is GAR, namely Galgalta ve Einayim, and the actual addition that comes at the time of Gadlut is Bina and ZON. Therefore he calls the Katnut by the name “anterior”, or GAR, and the Gadlut by the name “posterior”, or ZAT. Understand this well.
It has thus been explained that the male Atik, since he clothes in the place of the GAR of Nekudim, takes for the discernment of his Nukva everything that remained there of those GAR. However, from Bina, who is the Ima of Nekudim, he takes the first four Sefirot, that is, including the Hesed of Bina. The reason is that the light of Hesed is always found in Bina while she is in the posterior to Aba, and it does not come out from there except at the time when Ima turns her face to Aba, as the ARI writes above (page 326, and in the Inner Light, page 329, the passage beginning “And this is what he says”). Study it there well. And the seven Ketarim of the ZAT of BON, which the male Atik took, he took only for the discernment of his Guf, as is written below.

items.html:
Arich takes the last five of the Keter of BON, etc., and Aba takes the seven lower ones of the Hochma of BON, and Ima takes the six lower ones of the Bina of BON, and ZON take all the seven lower ones of BON: In order to understand these unions of MA and BON, and the necessity of these allotments that the ARI gave them, we must expand somewhat and give a faithful concept of the ten Sefirot of Atzilut in their full scope: how they are caused by one another and emerge one from the other, both the part of MA in each one and the part of BON in each one, and the union that is required of them in each and every Sefira.
Let us review briefly the matters that have been explained thus far. The beginning of everything was the general ascent of MAN [Mayin Nukvin] to the GAR of Nekudim, and from there to the Rosh of SAG, until the bottom Hey ascended to the forehead of SAG. For the screen thickened with no more than the coarseness that is found in Keter, and such thin coarseness raises only the level of Malchut, which, because of the correction of the lines in it, is called NHY. However, there is also there the discernment of the clothing of the last phase, which is the level of ZA of clothing, and therefore it is reckoned that HGT are clothed in the vessels of NHY. This is called “three within three”, or the Ibur [impregnation] of Atik. Study well what is written above, page 608, the passage beginning “Ibur”, and page 609, the passage beginning “And the reason”.
Now, this Ibur of Atik is really the discernment of the Ibur that corrects the whole of the MAN that ascended there, as written in the Inner Light mentioned above. It is for this reason that it was in the secret of the twelve-month Ibur, and it is for this reason that it immediately raised the whole of the vessels of the seven kings from BYA to the NHY of Atzilut, in the secret of a general Ibur for the vessels, as the ARI says above (page 600, item 3). However, a particular Ibur was needed as well, in which each lower one is corrected by its own upper one, as above in the words of the ARI (page 613, item 20).
It is also called the coupling of Katnut. After that came the coupling of Gadlut, as known. Yet know that here, in the coupling of Gadlut, there are two discernments: face to back and face to face, for the lower one is born only from a face to face coupling of the upper one. Therefore three couplings must be discerned here: the first is the coupling of Katnut, which is back to back and Ibur; the second is the coupling of Gadlut, which is the lowering of the bottom Hey from the place of the forehead, and this is the discernment of face to back, for there is no discernment of face to face except through MAN, as is well explained above in Part 7; the third is the coupling upon the MAN that rose to the Nukva, which is face to face.
You also know that all these levels, which emerge through the couplings of Katnut and Gadlut in Atzilut, are called by the name of the new MA. Moreover, even the discernments of the screen and the coarseness of the records, which are only from the Sefirot of the ten Sefirot of Nekudim and are certainly BON, are nevertheless considered vessels of MA. The reason is that the coupling with the upper light came out upon them, and they are the measurers of the levels in Atzilut, and hence they necessarily became vessels for MA, for the screen in the Malchut of the Rosh expands into ten Sefirot from her and within her, and becomes vessels for the ten Sefirot of Toch and Sof, which are called Guf, as known. Only the lights, that is, the records, the sparks and the old vessels, which already served to clothe the lights in the time of the kings, in the GAR and in the ZAT, are called by the name BON. And remember this.
Now, the construction of the Katnut of Atik was made from the inclusion of the screen in the bottom Hey of her own self, which is the choicest of the MAN and the records, as known, since with respect to the coupling, the coarser a thing is, the more excellent it is. Yet because of the weakness in the screen, which has no more than the discernment of Keter of its coarseness, it raised the bottom Hey to Keter, to the forehead, which is the Bina of Keter, as above. From here emerged the level of the Ibur of Atik, as above.
What caused the coupling of Gadlut of Atik is the remainder of the MAN that stayed there in the Rosh of SAG without any correction at all, for out of MA nothing emerged but the level of NHY, which was joined with the upper half of the Keter of BON in the correction of the lines back to back. The rest of the MAN, which are all four posteriors of AVI and YESHSUT and the seven lights of the ZAT, remained without any illumination whatsoever. These MAN caused the coupling of AB SAG, whose illumination of AB lowered the bottom Hey from the forehead to the Peh; and once the bottom Hey had descended to her place, the coarseness of phase four was again awakened in the screen, and the upper light that coupled with the screen raised the level of Keter. And after the coarseness of Nekudim that is in the screen was recognized, the screen returned to the Peh of Nekudim and raised ten Sefirot of Rosh at the level of Keter, from below upward, from the Peh of Nekudim to the Tabur of AK, that is, in the very place of the GAR of Nekudim (as above, page 611, the passage beginning “However”). And it has already been explained that this Gadlut is the discernment of face to back, since HB in these ten Sefirot are not face to face without MAN, as above. Therefore the level of Keter of the Rosh did not yet expand into the discernment of Guf, because the Bina of the Rosh stands back to back with Hochma, and hence only the discernment of Ruach Nefesh descended to the Guf, which is the level of ZA, without the illumination of Hochma.
And know that here the illumination of the Ibur reached the lower half of Keter. For you know that these two halves of the Ketarim were one single degree during the Gadlut of the GAR of Nekudim. However, because of the breaking of the kings, when the bottom Hey returned to the Einayim, the two halves of Keter were once more divided into two degrees, an upper one and a lower one, for GE remained in the degree while AHP went out from there and became a lower one. Therefore now, since through the new coupling of AB SAG the bottom Hey descended once again to the place of the Peh, the two halves of Keter again became a single degree.
Even so, the lower half of Keter did not return to the Rosh of Atik, and this is because of the doubled strength that had now been made in the Parsa, as above (page 622, the passage beginning “And in the beginning”. See there). It did, however, receive an illumination in its own place below, and this illumination is the illumination of the Ibur of AA in the NHY of Atik, which comes from the Rosh of Atik in the discernment of face to back, since the upper half of Keter had returned entirely to the discernment of Rosh by force of the level of Keter in the male of Atik, who bestowed upon her the discernment of new AHP, as written in its place. Therefore even the old AHP, from the side of BON, received at the very least a great correction. But since the Bina of Atik is still in the posterior to Aba, these AHP cannot receive more than the illumination of Ibur alone. Understand this well. Thus the Rosh and the Guf of Atik, and the discernment of the Ibur of AA, have been explained.
And after AA, which is the lower half of Keter, had been completed in all the discernments of the Ibur and was born in the discernment of Ruach Nefesh, it then rose as MAN to the Rosh of Atik, that is, to the upper half of Keter, which is the Nukva of Atik. By this it caused the discernment of the Bina of Atik to turn her face back to the Hochma of Atik, and the face to face coupling was made in HB of the Rosh of Atik, and the discernment of GAR reached the Guf of Atik as well. And when the coarseness of the AHP of Keter was recognized, from the side of Nekudim, from what had been there as Mochin for HB of Nekudim, as above, it then descended from there to the discernment of the Guf of Atik, and they raised ten Sefirot from below upward at the level of Hochma, and also in the discernment of face to back, like the Rosh of Atik before the ascent of MAN.
The reason it did not emerge at the level of Keter is that the more important coarseness, which is phase four, had already been drawn by the Partzuf of Atik to itself, and hence nothing remained in the whole of the MAN but the coarseness of phase three. And the level that emerged upon the coarseness of phase three is called the new MA, while the vessels of the AHP of Keter, which had already served in the time of the kings as Mochin for HB of Nekudim, are called BON, and they are the Nukva of AA. However, they had not yet expanded into a Guf of their own, other than Ruach Nefesh, because the Bina of the Rosh of AA is in the posterior to Hochma, as above with Atik.
And since the AHP of the Keter of BON had been corrected in the discernments of GAR for the Nukva of AA, the illumination of the Ibur reached from her to the ZAT of the Hochma and Bina of Nekudim, which are the discernment of the AHP of the HB that Atik took. For Atik took the discernment of GE of HB of Nekudim, which is the Katnut that remained after the breaking of the vessels, while the AHP, which are the posterior of HB that were nullified and which are counted as ZAT, are the ones that now received the illumination of the Ibur from the Nukva of AA. For the Nukva of AA, which is the AHP of Keter, has a direct connection with the AHP of HB from the time of the kings, when they clothed one within the other and the AHP of Keter were their Mochin. Therefore now, too, it would have been fitting that the AHP of HB should rise to the Rosh of AA and clothe the AHP of Keter there, so that both would be corrected in a single correction. But by force of the strength of the Parsa they cannot rise, as above. Yet for this reason they receive the illumination of the Nukva of AA in their own place below, and this illumination is regarded as an illumination of Ibur, because the Bina of the Rosh of AA is still in the discernment of posterior toward Hochma, and hence they receive only the illumination of the fetus. Thus the Gadlut of the Rosh and the Guf of AA, in the discernment of face to back, has been explained, and also the discernment of the Ibur of the Hochma and Bina of Atzilut, which are called AVI.
And after AVI of Atzilut, who are the ZAT of HB of BON, had been completed in all the discernments of the Ibur and were born in the discernment of Ruach Nefesh by virtue of the illumination of the Rosh of AA in the discernment of face to back, AVI then rose as MAN to the Nukva of the Rosh of AA, which is the AHP of the Keter of BON. By this they caused the Bina of the Rosh of AA to turn her face back to the Hochma of the Rosh of AA, face to face, and HB of the Rosh of AA coupled face to face, and then the illumination of GAR reached the Guf of AA as well. And after the coarseness in the ZAT of HB that had risen as MAN was recognized, they returned to their place in the Guf of AA and raised the level of Bina from below upward, out of the coarseness; and there is also a level of Hochma out of the clothing, as known. They too were in the discernment of face to back, as above with Atik and AA. And the reason they did not emerge at the level of Hochma is that AA had already drawn the coarseness of phase three from the whole of the MAN, and nothing remained in them but the coarseness of phase two. And the level of Bina that emerged upon phase two is called the new MA, while the discernment of the vessels of the ZAT of Hochma and Bina is called BON.
And after the Rosh of AVI had been completed in the discernment of the GAR of Bina, in the discernment of face to back, the illumination of Ruach Nefesh reached the Guf of AVI, and the illumination of Ibur also reached the ZAT of Nekudim. This is because they have the relation of a single Partzuf, Rosh and Guf, from the time of the kings, as known. And after the ZAT had been completed in all the discernments of the Ibur, they were born and came outside in the discernment of Ruach Nefesh.
Thus the Rosh and the Guf of AVI have been explained, and also the discernment of the Katnut of ZON, for the MA of ZON is the illumination of the Ibur that it received from the Rosh of AVI, and is reckoned as the ZAT of MA, while the BON of ZON is the ZAT of Nekudim, as above.
